item.title: 'I couldn't believe it': Millard auto shop donates fully repaired Toyota Prius to woman in need
item.description: A Millard shop donated a fully repaired 2006 Toyota Prius to a 70-year-old Council Bluffs woman living on Social Security.

item.title: Sunday snow to Friday storms, an active weather week is ahead for Omaha
item.description: It's the first day of meteorological Spring, and the seasonal battle begins! From snow south of I-80 today to a chance of thunderstorms (not severe) on Friday, check out this week's forecast.
